pullRequests.title: Release v0.10.0
pullRequests.author: Veradictus
pullRequests.head: develop
pullRequests.body:
Everything on develop since v0.9.0, for release as v0.10.0.

#115 (chore/release-0.10.0) must merge into develop first, so that this PR carries the version bump and launcher/release-notes/0.10.0.md. Until then it would release as 0.9.0.

Release checklist (from launcher/docs/RELEASING.md)

 Merge #115 (the bump and the notes) into develop.
 Merge this PR into master.
 Tag the merged commit on master and push the tag:
git fetch origin && git checkout master && git pull --ff-only && git tag…
